w2a_binding_draft_points: Capital scale uses ex-ante frozen schedule/sign-cost commitment only, never realized prices or PnL.
Short sale proceeds are restricted and cannot fund new positions; negative free cash fails closed.
Starting capital C0=1 is the initial drawdown high-water mark.
Matched-SPY uses identical sign/dates/notional/overlap and is the primary active comparator.
Primary uncertainty bootstrap uses additive active daily PnL, not a difference of separately compounded percentage returns.
HAC Sharpe and Sortino are secondary descriptive metrics.
Gate 0 legacy reconciliation precedes all real portfolio reporting.
w2b_binding_draft_points: IAS dimensions are PAC, LSO, SIB, TAW and PSI; feasibility does not add IAS points.
ECG A/B/C maps to triangular anchor uncertainty; ECG-D is unresolved Uniform(0,5), not a zero score.
Central score is equal-weight mean when evidence complete; global robustness uses Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1) SMAA.
Robust-high requires IAS central >=3 and P(IAS>=3)>=0.75 plus evidence gate.
Highest-asymmetry claim requires rank-1 acceptability >=0.50 and >=0.05 margin over runner-up.
All F1-F9 feasibility gates pass before a family can be eligible to draft W3.
W2 GO authorizes W3 protocol drafting only; W3 execution requires an independently frozen adequacy-tested design.
Practical IAS ties are resolved for experiment selection by pre-frozen feasibility, never ARGOS performance.
global_prohibitions: No W2A normalization or sizing selected using realized returns or NAV.
No family selection or IAS scoring using ARGOS PnL, Brier, log loss, H2 incremental results, or realized linked-asset returns.
No invented historical borrow fee or mandatory unavailable input.
No real W2A output or real IAS family score before byte-freezing the corresponding reviewed protocol.
No W3 execution directly from a W2 GO decision.
next_action: Byte-freeze the reviewed W2A and W2B drafts without substantive changes, or create a new draft version and rerun all 38 synthetic cases before freeze.
